messages:
Diego R.: Hi all — I accepted the orientation invite but my calendar shows it at 12:00 local (I'm in SGT) while the email said 10:00 SGT. Did anyone else see a mismatch?

Nora M.: Yup, mine's weird too. I think my calendar client applied daylight savings differently. I'm in AEST and it shifted by an hour.

DevEx Priya: Thanks for flagging. We had a couple of invites created in different timezones which caused some clients to resolve differently. Short fixes: 1) We reissued a single canonical invite in UTC and attached a new ICS. 2) If you imported an old ICS, it may be stuck in your local cache — please remove old entries before importing the new one.

DevEx Priya: Canonical join (UTC event): https://redwood.zoom.us/j/3333333333?pwd=onboardUTC
Passcode: RedwoodOnboard

DevEx Priya: New ICS download here: https://calendar.redwood.com/ical/onboarding-utc-2026.ics  (this ICS uses proper TZ identifiers so most clients should map correctly)

IT Sam: For folks on corporate-managed Outlook: if you see two events after import, clear your cached calendars: File > Options > Advanced > Cached Exchange Mode settings > "Download shared folders" toggle off/on, then restart Outlook. That typically forces a resync.

Nora M.: Any guidance for mobile calendar apps? I don't want to miss the Q&A.

DevEx Priya: On iOS/Android, delete the event and re-open the invite email then tap the updated .ics attachment. If you subscribed to a calendar feed, do a manual refresh of the subscription in settings. We also scheduled a duplicate-friendly reminder: email 24h, calendar 1h, device 15m.

Diego R.: Thanks — one more weird thing: the old invite had the meeting named "Orientation - Redwood" and the new one says "Redwood Onboarding Session" so it looked like a different event. Can you standardize titles?

DevEx Priya: Good catch. We standardized the title to "Redwood New Hire Orientation" and updated descriptions to include track links and whether the session is live or recorded. Apologies for churn.

calendar-bot: Recording will be uploaded within 45 minutes after the session ends: https://drive.redwood.com/onboarding/recordings/pending-link

IT Sam: If anyone still has issues after trying the steps, DM me and I can remove the stray event from your calendar server-side.
